calendar: source observation dates; never forward-fill; latest intraday excluded

units.marginDailyYi: TWD 100 million daily finance balance change, including ETF
units.foreignNetYi: TWD 100 million, TWSE foreign institution cash net
units.marginMaintenanceExEtf: percent, Wantgoo margin maintenance excludes ETF
units.us10yYield: percent, 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED DGS10)
units.us10y2ySpread: percentage points, 10-year minus 2-year Treasury constant maturity spread (FRED T10Y2Y)
units.voo: USD per VOO share, Yahoo Finance daily unadjusted Close; distributions excluded
units.qqq: USD per QQQ share, Yahoo Finance daily unadjusted Close; distributions excluded
units.fedFundsEffective: percent, effective federal funds overnight rate, FRED DFF (not FOMC target range)
units.marketTurnoverYiTwd: TWD 100 million market trading value, TWSE FMTQIK 成交金額
units.dayTradeTurnoverYiTwd: TWD 100 million, (TWSE day-trade buy TWD + sell TWD)/2
units.dayTradeTurnoverSharePct: percent, TWSE day-trade avg buy/sell TWD value divided by FMTQIK market trading TWD value
